name: autonomous-sdr-backend
description: Backend for the Autonomous SDR Control Plane (Inter Guild Buildathon 2026). Implements the campaign/prospect/decision/approval/agent/settings API consumed by src/services/api.js in the frontend, plus the agent orchestration, RAG and conflict-resolution logic behind it.

scripts.test: node --test test/dronahqEngine.test.js test/geminiEngine.test.js test/costControl.test.js test/storage.test.js test/campaigns.test.js test/goldenIcp.test.js test/cadence.test.js test/scheduler.test.js test/agentPlans.test.js test/grounding.test.js test/auth.test.js test/prompts.test.js test/reps.test.js test/blueprint.test.js test/research.test.js test/meetings.test.js test/dev.test.js
scripts.reset-data: node -e "import('./src/db/index.js').then(m => m.resetState()).then(() => { console.log('State reset to seed.'); process.exit(0); })"
